name: Barbell Garage Gym
description: Three full-body workouts a week for 12 weeks with what fits in a garage: a barbell and plates, a power rack with a pull-up bar and a flat bench that inclines. Each workout has a squat or deadlift, a press, a row or pull-up and some accessory work. The weights rise through three blocks with a deload in week 9. Lift inside the rack with the safety bars set just below your lowest position. Exercises marked optional add arms, shoulders, calves or abs for a longer day; leave them out when short of time.

phases.name: Base
phases.description: Three sets of eight to ten

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Sets of five to six on the main lifts

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

phases.name: Strength
phases.description: Sets of three to five on the main lifts
